shared_elements: horizontal register of repeated rectangular/arch-shaped units along the upper edge
horizontal dividing band separating upper register from lower field
band of short repeated vertical strokes / fringe-like pattern
curvilinear looped or hook-shaped motif in low relief
carved low-relief motifs arranged in stacked registers
justification: The clearest correspondence is compositional rather than iconographic: both surfaces open with a row of repeated boxy/arched units along the top, cut off by a horizontal dividing band with a fringe of short vertical strokes, above a larger field of relief motifs. Beyond that they depict quite different things — B is populated by recognisable creatures (a quadruped in profile, small birds, a long-necked bird, a snake-like form) arranged loosely over the field, while A shows only abstract rectilinear cartouches, straight-edged frames and a large closed loop with no identifiable animate figures at all.
